segments.an4.101:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.an4.101:2.3: Gajjitā no vassitā, vassitā no gajjitā, neva gajjitā no vassitā, gajjitā ca vassitā ca.
segments.an4.101:2.8: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro valāhakūpamā [pu. pa.157] puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
segments.an4.101:2.10: Gajjitā no vassitā, vassitā no gajjitā, neva gajjitā no vassitā, gajjitā ca vassitā ca.
segments.an4.101:3.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo gajjitā hoti no vassitā?
segments.an4.101:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo bhāsitā hoti, no kattā.
segments.an4.101:3.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo gajjitā hoti, no vassitā.
segments.an4.101:3.4: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, valāhako gajjitā, no vassitā;
segments.an4.101:4.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo vassitā hoti, no gajjitā?
segments.an4.101:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kattā hoti, no bhāsitā.
segments.an4.101:4.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo vassitā hoti, no gajjitā.
segments.an4.101:4.4: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, valāhako vassitā, no gajjitā;
segments.an4.101:5.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo neva gajjitā hoti, no vassitā?
segments.an4.101:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo neva bhāsitā hoti, no kattā.
segments.an4.101:5.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo neva gajjitā hoti, no vassitā.
segments.an4.101:5.4: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, valāhako neva gajjitā [neva gajjitā hoti (ka.)], no vassitā;
segments.an4.101:6.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca?
segments.an4.101:6.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo bhāsitā ca hoti kattā ca.
segments.an4.101:6.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca.
segments.an4.101:6.4: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, valāhako gajjitā ca [gajjitā ca hoti (ka.)] vassitā ca;
segments.an4.101:6.6: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro valāhakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.

lines: Bhāsitā hoti no kattāti “idañcidañca karissāmī”ti kevalaṃ bhāsatiyeva, na karoti.
Kattā hoti no bhāsitāti akathetvāva “idañcidañca mayā kātuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti kattā hoti.
Manussā hi yadā devo gajjati, tadā “suvuṭṭhitā bhavissatī”ti bījāni nīharitvā vapanti.
Atha deve avassante khette bījāni khetteyeva nassanti, gehe bījāni geheyeva nassantīti dubbhikkhaṃ hoti.
Manussā hi imasmiṃ kāle “dubbuṭṭhikā bhavissatī”ti ninnaṭṭhānesuyeva vappaṃ karonti.
Atha devo vassitvā sabbabījāni mahāsamuddaṃ pāpeti, dubbhikkhameva hoti.
Bhāsitā hoti no kattāti “idāni ganthadhuraṃ pūressāmi, vāsadhuraṃ pūressāmī”ti kathetiyeva, na uddesaṃ gaṇhāti, na kammaṭṭhānaṃ bhāveti.
Kattā hoti no bhāsitāti “ganthadhuraṃ pūressāmi, vāsadhuraṃ vā”ti na bhāsati, sampatte pana kāle samattaṃ sampādeti.
Atha vā sabbaṃ panetaṃ paccayadāyakeheva kathitaṃ.
Eko hi “asukadivase nāma dānaṃ dassāmī”ti saṅghaṃ nimanteti, sampatte kāle no karoti.
Ayaṃ puggalo puññena parihāyati, bhikkhusaṅgho pana lābhena parihāyati.
Aparo saṅghaṃ animantetvā sakkāraṃ katvā “bhikkhū ānessāmī”ti na labhi, sabbe aññattha nimantitā honti.
Ayampi puññena parihāyati, saṅghopi lābhena parihāyati.
Aparo paṭhamaṃ saṅghaṃ nimantetvā pacchā sakkāraṃ katvā dānaṃ deti, ayaṃ kiccakārī hoti.
Aparo neva saṅghaṃ nimanteti, na dānaṃ deti, ayaṃ pāpapuggaloti veditabbo.
